name: eda
description: EDA routing: an 'explore this dataset' request should reach the Analysis specialist and surface the strong units_sold↔revenue relationship. The {{EDA_CSV}} token is replaced with the absolute path to evals/fixtures/eda_sample.csv at run time (see tests/test_eval.py).

parts.text: Load the local CSV at {{EDA_CSV}}, then explore it: which numeric column is most strongly correlated with revenue?
units_sold is very strongly positively correlated with revenue (correlation near 1.0); discount_pct is negatively related.
